title: Authority docs / Integration slot / exact GitHub baseline

behavior: MCP canonical documents and canonical-state keys remain the default declaration with identical historical behavior.

GW-21 consumes only bounded inventory/declaration/cartography digests and counts; drift/stale/unavailable evidence fails closed.
GW-22 derives an integration slot only from existing Current State module/document/tool inventories and never invents an owner.
GW-22 refuses stale or unavailable inventory evidence.
GW-23 reuses current GitHub observation, binds the exact work-branch SHA to the current step, rejects pre-step replay, head contradictions and stale/unavailable required sub-evidence.
All outputs are read/derive-only, authorizationInferred=false, mutationPerformed=false, with no persistence.
